end.summary:
Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers in words and numerals.
Correctly represented 4,000 and 6,042, including the zero in the hundreds place.
Corrected the initial reading of “paintalees” from 35 to 45 and wrote 2,345.
Wrote 8,614 from “aath hazaar chhah sau chaudah.”
Zero in an empty place was still omitted in one observed example; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place value and writing 4-digit numbers from number names. Diya used place-value parts successfully in examples such as 6,042 and corrected “paintalees” to 45 later in the lesson. They still need practice keeping a zero in an empty place, such as writing 4,050 rather than 450. At home, practise three number names each day and ask them to say each place aloud, including any zero place.
